name: Why are my mobile home baseboards pulling away from the wall?

mainEntity.name: Why are my mobile home baseboards pulling away from the wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Loose baseboards can stem from age, thermal expansion, moisture, or structural settling. Manufactured homes naturally shift over time on their pier-and-beam foundations, which can loosen trim nails. High humidity or water leaks can also warp baseboards and deteriorate the adhesive holding them against the wallboard. If the nails pulled completely out of the wall, the fastener likely missed a stud or the stud softened. Securing them properly often requires locating solid framing points, using construction adhesive, and driving fresh finish nails at alternating angles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foundation settling, wall movement, failed adhesive, or moisture intrusion frequently cause mobile home baseboards to pull loose from framing over time.
